name: RuntimeDiscoveryAgent
description: Opens the live deployment in Playwright (logging in with a test account when configured), crawls its pages and inspects DOM, forms, buttons, downloads, chat interfaces, authentication and network calls, and outputs a runtime profile with a preliminary app type and candidate user flows.

inputs.name: live_url
inputs.description: Deployed app URL (skipped when brd_only or empty)

inputs.name: repo_graph
inputs.description: Knowledge graph: page and API routes used as crawl hints

inputs.name: live_credentials
inputs.description: {username, password} test account, decrypted at run time

outputs.name: runtime_profile
outputs.description: app_type, forms, buttons, downloads, chat_interface, authentication, pages, api_calls, user_flows, gated_pages, needs_credentials, login
